name: Visual Novel
description: A visual-novel scene: a soft, blurred painted background, a large original anime-style character bust drawn in code with big glossy eyes, swapping expressions, and a translucent dialogue box with a name tag and typewriter text.
style: Original code-drawn anime bust (layered hair with shine, big eyes with highlights, blush) on a soft blurred painted background; dark translucent dialogue box with pink border and name tag, text typed at ~28 characters a second, expression effects (sweat, sparkles, shock lines), ending on a two-option choice menu. M PLUS Rounded 1c throughout.
